description.zh:
指定要操作API的环境。

- **RELEASE**: 线上
- **PRE**: 预发
- **TEST**: 测试
description.en:
Specify the environment where you want to manage the API.

- **RELEASE**: Production

- **PRE**: Pre-release

- **TEST**: Test

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi create-backend-model --backend-id 34e94fcd3e2e47a49824a89b8f92cb5e --backend-type HTTP --stage-name TEST --backend-model-data ServiceAddress_:_http://apigateway.alicloudapi.com:8080 --description model_description --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
